# Big-Research v2.2.0

Big-Research v2.2.0 makes Codex setup easier to diagnose and uses a consistent display name across the plugin directory, research skills and workspace interface. The stable installation identifier remains `big-research`.

The quickstart now checks whether a Codex CLI supports plugin commands before installation and includes Windows multi-version troubleshooting. Existing research data and project behavior are unchanged.

Install `big-research@big-research-marketplace` and start with `$big-research` in Codex or `/big-research:big-research` in Claude Code. Existing research data is preserved; point `BIG_RESEARCH_HOME` at its current location to continue working.

[Get started](https://github.com/HaoYangJin/Big-Research/blob/v2.2.0/docs/quickstart.md)
